findings.summary: The byte-range filter OVERWRITES row_group_indices rather than intersecting with reader.all_row_groups(opts). This is equivalent today only because opts (a copy of *_reader_options) never carries a row-group selection — I grepped every opts.* mutation between the copy at :688 and the call at :815 and the only one is opts.set_filter(). If anyone later calls set_row_groups on _reader_options, a ranged scan would silently discard that selection and read row groups the caller excluded.

tests.summary: Exact CI command fails at the final link on this aarch64 box: exit 101, 476 'undefined reference' errors in libsirius.so (cudf/rmm/spdlog/yaml-cpp/fmt symbols) preceded by 13 ld warnings 'libcudf.so (etc.), needed by .../libsirius.so, not found (try using -rpath or -rpath-link)'.
